name: connect-service-configurations-create
description: What: Create (or update) the 5 Main-track Connect service configurations on the Main instance ('Service Configuration Profisee To Profisee' belongs to connect\profisee-to-profisee). Run it through connect-objects-reset, which clears the old Connect objects first: a Connect import of an existing id fails (403 duplicated Id), it never updates. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: reference values: connect/databases:ConnectExportDB, connect/databases:ModelSourceDB, connect/machines:DatabaseServerNameFQDN, connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.

parameters.ServiceConfigName: Service Configuration SQL Server Model Source

inline.description: What: Import 'Service Configuration SQL Server Model Source' (copied from QA 'SC_CORPDTR3_SQL_Server_ModelSource_Small', id 602caf62-1ebb-8426-7487-d38a3a32f282). Why: Drives Connect (strategies, service configurations, batches) through its REST API for ''. Success: Connect accepts the Import call with an expected status code. If it fails: Check the Connect address (connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl) answers and the Connect API key works; 400 or 409 usually means the object already exists or the artifact does not fit this Profisee release.
